description: What to build with Helious and how: for a stated goal, the tools to call in order, what each returns, what it costs in credits at your cadence, and which plan covers it. Use this when someone is building an integration, a bot, a dashboard or a strategy, before the first data call.

cadence.description: How often it will run, like every 15 minutes, hourly, daily, every trading day or weekly. Prices the month; daily when empty.

client.description: The client or stack it runs in, like claude, chatgpt, cursor or a script.

goal.description: What the person is building, in their words, like a bot that trades CPI, a macro regime dashboard or a CPI forecast. Empty returns the three things people build, in short form.

language.description: python, javascript or another language, to point at the right sample.

name: get_build_plan
title: Plan an integration
